# Icon

Line icon from the built-in Lucide set (ISC licence, icons-LICENSE.txt), drawn on a 24px grid with a 2px stroke in currentColor.

`KenosUI.Icon` · Foundations

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Icon name={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Icon" name="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Lucide line icon (ISC), 24px grid, 2px stroke, currentColor. `Icon.names` lists all names.

## Props (IconProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` * | `IconName` |  |
| `size` | `number \| string` | Default 1em (inherits font size). |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` | Give it a label only when it stands alone and means something. |

_Also accepts: React.SVGAttributes<SVGSVGElement>._
